_description: Requirement-level state tracking in a single file. Each sub-requirement independently tracks UI truth capability, design-contract review evidence, blocker details, and resume target.

_status_meanings.draft: Newly created with uncertain boundaries - source_ref coverage, normalized statements, or dependencies are incomplete
_status_meanings.split_ready: Complete source_ref coverage, normalized statements, explicit scope, and dependencies - ready to enter the next stage
_status_meanings.acceptance_frozen: The enabled UI truth capability has a CP-UI-authorized real component, runtime coverage matrix, official previews, and per-scenario evidence scopes frozen in the user-approved workspace; v3 contracts/ui-truth-index.json provenance, profiles, scenarios, scope decisions, required host bindings, coverage, paths, SHA-256 hashes, preview-bound static confirmations, and a separate motion_decision for every unit are valid (ui_truth_mode=figma or runtime-baseline only)
_status_meanings.design_ready: The canonical design.md contains the behavior and acceptance contract, implementation-relevant decisions, and the required state-flow depth; its current bytes have a valid self or human review
_status_meanings.in_dev: Remaining implementation work is in progress - UI truth slices reuse the Stage 2 user-approved workspace and the TDD loop is active
_status_meanings.visual_acceptance_passed: The implementation passed every indexed visual/runtime scenario and structured visual-acceptance.json binds the current UI truth index with independent motion_acceptance for every unit (including GIF evidence or runtime verification when applicable; ui_truth_mode=figma or runtime-baseline only; other modes skip this state)
_status_meanings.merged: Code has been rebased and integrated into the development branch without a merge commit
_status_meanings.archived: Archived in place - status is converged while canonical artifacts remain in their original locations; requirement changes require a new <req-id>
_status_meanings.blocked_missing_requirement: The source lacks critical business facts
_status_meanings.blocked_requirement_conflict: Two approved sources conflict with each other
_status_meanings.blocked_dependency: An upstream sub-requirement is not ready
_status_meanings.blocked_missing_design: Required UI truth evidence or solution-design input is missing
_status_meanings.blocked_requirement_figma_conflict: The requirement and visual truth conflict irreconcilably
_status_meanings.blocked_figma_conflict: Design evidence from different providers conflicts
_status_meanings.blocked_missing_state_code: The final screen state lacks structured framework evidence
_status_meanings.blocked_missing_visual_truth: The default state, row combinations, parent shell, or key assets are missing
_status_meanings.blocked_design_mismatch: The canonical design contract conflicts with governed truth
_status_meanings.blocked_dependency_slice: An upstream slice has not been merged
_status_meanings.blocked_verification_failure: Tests, review, or visual acceptance still fail after automated fixes

_blocker_scope_meanings.slice_local: A blocker limited to one slice, stage, or capability surface. By default it must not block unrelated slices or stages.
_blocker_scope_meanings.action_level_integration: A blocker limited to real API wiring or final semantic closure for one action. It does not block visual mapping, shell work, local state work, navigation scaffolding, or safe read-only paths.
_blocker_scope_meanings.requirement_global: Pausing the entire requirement is allowed only when every currently derivable queue item is unrunnable. If any safe runnable item exists, the blocker is not requirement-global.

_checkpoints.CP-UI: ui_visual_implementation_authorization - a UI truth capability slice awaits user authorization to write the production component, golden tests, and preview; workspace choice is governed separately
_checkpoints.CP-002: hard_blocker_pause - no safe runnable queue items remain for the current requirement; this checkpoint is allowed only when no runnable item exists
_checkpoints.CP-DESIGN: user_design_decision - user_decision_required=true classifies a design version that requires human authority and remains true after approval; the checkpoint is pending only while the current bytes lack a valid hash-bound human review
_checkpoints.CP-ARCHIVE: archive_confirmation - all slices are merged and await user confirmation to archive their status in place

_runtime_modes.bootstrap: status.json is missing or incomplete, or the queue cannot be derived safely - start from the first governed stage
_runtime_modes.resume: At least one unresolved or runnable queue item remains after reconciliation, and no checkpoint actively prevents execution
_runtime_modes.confirm_ui: current_checkpoint=CP-UI; a ui_truth_mode=figma or runtime-baseline slice awaits authorization for controlled visual implementation; NEXT_ACTION=none until confirmed
_runtime_modes.confirm_solution_design: current_checkpoint=CP-DESIGN; the current user-authority design version lacks a valid hash-bound human review and must be resolved before implementation
_runtime_modes.blocker_recovery: current_checkpoint=CP-002; the user supplied the missing decision or the external blocker has cleared
_runtime_modes.closing: current_checkpoint=CP-ARCHIVE; all executable slices are merged and await user confirmation to archive status in place
